notice: Frozen holdout authored on 2026-11-05 *after* the abstention threshold and the generation/retrieval fixes were frozen. These questions are not variants of golden v1/v2 wording and were never used to choose a threshold, a rule or a parameter. They are executed once, at the end of the qualification run, and the result is reported whether or not it is flattering. If a case fails, the failure is classified in docs/final_qualification/acceptance_matrix.md and is not silenced by tuning.
